intent: Reassess historical images using new Jianxi-inspired readability and optical-risk gates; this is retrospective technical cross-word regression, NOT prospective aesthetic transfer, independent blind review, or a new production iteration.

A.file_name: 透明背景上的黑色宋体汉字“松间见月”.png

checks_before_result.source_hash: Require exact raw SHA256 match with R23/R24 historical ledger, same size 1672x941, RGBA
checks_before_result.source_ink_mask: Composite RGBA on white. Ink pixel means grayscale <180 AND original alpha >=32. Exclude image edges and count only actual ink bbox; do not count transparent RGB zero as ink.
checks_before_result.scale: Normalize each arm independently to equal 256px ink height for larger visual pair and to ink heights 96,64,32 for size stress. Always preserve original aspect ratio; never distort a glyph independently.
row_metrics: ink density in bbox at original resolution
number and widths of entirely blank vertical column runs in the central ink band, considering separations as evidence only and NOT actual character segmentation
checks_before_result.contour_checks: Report hole / character counter changes only as heuristic, not correctness or certified glyph count; if segmentation unreliable leave UNKNOWN
checks_before_result.goal: Test whether stronger art treatment automatically improves commercial logo usability; examine whether high-density and near-connected glyphs remain separable at smaller scale.
checks_before_result.falsification: If historical B arms do not have reduced horizontal blank columns or small-size internal-space compression, do not conclude that expressive styles systematically cause the Jianxi risks. Do not fabricate a positive transfer test if image metadata do not substantiate it.

next_decision: Based on measured risks, produce a visual QA worksheet and explicit fail or abstain on rule portability; leave a genuine new unseen-word creative test for a future separately authorized controlled generation with independent human review.
